location.zh: 菲尼克斯禁地 · 白虎

strategy_notes.zh: 依照试炼顺序挑战，战斗中的对手会连续出战。

engine_notes: Avatar HP 3000 (fighting) and 2500 (electric) are from 4399 2011-03-11. Lv105 and both four-move loadouts are the official boss forms 2513-2516 (2013 PetXMLInfo, seer_data monsters.json). Fighting then electric order is source-backed. The fighting avatar adds one priority step, as the March 2011 guide states, rather than using an absolute-first override.
The original fought each avatar as a separate single-boss battle (first stage, then the strengthened second stage); the remake keeps one two-member team.

uncertain: Exact server IV/EV/nature, attack-stat scaling and guardian HP not recovered unless separately cited.

source_note: Historical order and specified effects are reconstructed from the cited period gameplay reports. Level 105 is the official map-table level; IV 31, zero EVs and hardy nature are explicit remake calibration; copied guardian skill sets are catalog-based, not certified historical boss loadouts.
